title: Inadequate Authentication
description: The student may not be adequately authenticated, allowing unauthorized access to the grades portal.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data such as student ID and assignment details may be intercepted during transmission.

title: Improper Data Storage
description: The grades portal may store sensitive student data insecurely, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Unclear Data Usage Policies
description: The grades portal may not clearly communicate how student data will be used, leading to privacy concerns.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The grades portal may unintentionally share sensitive student information (e.g., student ID, course details) with unauthorized parties due to misconfigurations or errors in the submission process.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit between the grades portal and the assignment & grading service could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The assignment & grading service may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Uncontrolled Data Retention
description: The assignment & grading service may retain student data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose student data (ID, course, submission time) to unauthorized personnel during the assignment submission process.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The assignment store may not implement adequate security measures, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized access to stored assignments.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted from the grading service to the assignment store may be intercepted, leading to exposure of sensitive information such as student IDs and submission times.

title: Unauthorized Access to Teacher's Account
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the teacher's account if proper authentication measures are not in place, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the teacher and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors if not properly encrypted, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The portal may inadvertently expose student names and submissions to unauthorized teachers or staff due to misconfigured access controls.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Teacher
description: The teacher may mishandle or improperly store the displayed student data, leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized sharing.

title: Data Leakage through Metadata
description: Metadata associated with the data flow (e.g., timestamps, IP addresses) could be intercepted during transmission, revealing information about student submissions.

title: Inadvertent Disclosure of Student Information
description: The teacher may inadvertently disclose sensitive student information (e.g., student ID) when recording grades and feedback, especially if the system does not enforce strict access controls or if the teacher is not careful about what information is shared.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades and Feedback
description: The Grades Portal Web App may be vulnerable to unauthorized access, allowing individuals who should not have access to view or manipulate grades and feedback.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data transmitted from the teacher to the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to grades and feedback.

title: Data Retention and Misuse
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain grades and feedback longer than necessary, increasing the risk of misuse or unauthorized access to this data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grading service and submit or modify grade records, leading to potential data breaches and integrity issues.

title: Insecure Storage of Grade Records
description: The grade records database may not have adequate security measures, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks.

title: Data Exposure During Transmission
description: Grade records may be intercepted during transmission from the grading service to the database if proper encryption is not used.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The grade records may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse of personal data.

title: Unclear Data Sharing Policies
description: Users may not be aware of how their data is being used or shared, leading to a lack of trust in the grading service.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The student may unintentionally share their request for grades with unauthorized parties if the request is made from a shared or public device.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The grades and feedback may be stored insecurely on the Grades Portal, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: Data in transit between the student and the Grades Portal may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Misuse by the Portal
description: The Grades Portal may misuse the data received from the student, such as using it for profiling or marketing purposes without consent.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Grades Portal may retain the student's data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grades and feedback intended for a specific student due to insufficient access controls on the portal.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The student's grades and feedback may be stored insecurely on the student's device, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or interception.

title: Data Leakage through Metadata
description: Metadata associated with the data flow, such as timestamps or IP addresses, could potentially reveal information about the student's access patterns or identity.

title: Data Misuse by Student
description: The student may misuse the information received, such as sharing their grades or feedback with unauthorized individuals.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child's Grades
description: A parent may inadvertently share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to access sensitive information about the child’s grades.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades in an insecure manner, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the parent and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to their child's grades if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The parent may store the grades and feedback insecurely on their device, leading to potential unauthorized access by others.

title: Data Leakage during Transmission
description: Grades and feedback may be intercepted during transmission if the data flow is not encrypted, leading to exposure of sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Access to Administrator Account
description: An unauthorized individual may gain access to the school administrator's account, allowing them to create, modify, or disable accounts and parent-child links, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive information (names, emails, roles, relationships) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Data being transmitted from the School Administrator to the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Misuse by Application
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data it receives from the administrator, such as sharing it with unauthorized third parties or using it for purposes not consented to by the data subjects.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Records
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose account records to unauthorized users during the writing process.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The account directory may not have adequate security measures in place to protect sensitive account information from unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Account Directory
description: The account directory may misuse the data it receives from the grading service, such as using it for purposes other than intended, leading to privacy violations.

title: Data Linkability Risks
description: The data flow may allow for the linking of account records with other datasets, potentially leading to the identification of individuals without their consent.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The assignment and grading service may inadvertently share sensitive student data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent or authorization.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: During the nightly database backup, sensitive data such as grades and assignments may be intercepted during transmission to the cloud hosting provider.

title: Inadequate Data Protection by Third Party
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement adequate security measures to protect the stored sensitive data, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Third Party
description: The cloud hosting provider may misuse the data for purposes other than those agreed upon, such as selling or sharing it with unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grade Records
description: An unauthorized entity may gain access to the grade records stored in the Grade Records Database, leading to potential misuse of sensitive student information.

title: Inaccurate Data Representation
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may misrepresent or incorrectly display grade records, leading to misinformation for students, parents, and teachers.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may retain grade records longer than necessary, increasing the risk of data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of grade records from the database to the grading service, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.
